title: The Last Voice Note
synopsis: When Mira receives a voice note from her missing brother, she returns to the hill town they once called home. The message ends with a warning: do not trust the man at the station. As a storm traps her overnight, Mira must decide whether to follow the voice or escape the secret waiting in the dark.
